name: Link and Unlink a deal with contacts and companies
description: Link and Unlink a deal with contacts and companies. Link or unlink contacts and companies with a specific deal in a single request. You can simultaneously link new contacts/companies and unlink existing ones by providing the respective ID arrays in the request body.

linkCompanyIds.description: Company ids to be linked with deal

linkContactIds.description: Contact ids for contacts to be linked with deal

unlinkCompanyIds.description: Company ids to be unlinked from deal

unlinkContactIds.description: Contact ids for contacts to be unlinked from deal
